title: Kid Rena band members and other clarinettists
summary: He names men in Rena's band, including T-Boy and Zeb, and clarinettists George Abbott and Joe Watson who played by ear.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who else was in Rene's band?
Well that was Rene, Zeb, Morris French. The band you play was... Oh, what's the spell name again? I believe it was T-Boy. You hear about it?
Yeah, I've heard the name too. No, that's... I'm thinking of a bass band.
No, T-Boy's a bass player. They got T-Boy Rene and me play trumpet too, you know. Yeah, then they got a T-Boy, I believe he was playing bands with Kid Rene too.
Well, he was brown skinned, slim brown, with big eyes I believe.
No, it was about his height. Not Ralph's height? Yeah, not as tall as him. About his height, it's about his height.
Hey, Lewis, I meant to ask you, did you ever know any other name for Zeb? Zeb?

No, I don't. All in the day I know Zeb and I went playing with Rene. You all hear George Abbott. You know George Abbott, played with Kid Puncher Band, clarinet player too. And Joe Watson? Who did he play with? Joe Watson played with Sam Morgan's band. Joe Watson played clarinet. You don't know Virta Carl? I've heard of him. Joe Watson's old timers. He's an old timers. They say he was good. Good clarinet player. Politely spelled like George Abbott.
Well they didn't read the music. But they could play it. They could play though.

They had good ear. Yeah. Oh I didn't get down about that E-line. Oh when Zooty worked there? Let's see the, I believe, probably Mutt Carey was there. I played with Mutt Carey. I played with Mutt Carey. Mutt Carey. Mutt Carey had a way to take him to play. He was a part of the music. He was a part of the music.
Well they didn't read the music. But they could play it.
They could play though. They had good ear.
